name: Echoes of a Wildflower
source:
Faith arrives in Willowvale looking for answers about Maya’s sudden disappearance. Each Polaroid and personal account reveals both affection for Maya and the hidden pain she carried. 

Faith follows these threads to find her and help her heal.

[From [url=https://faeflower.itch.io/echoes-of-a-wildflower]Itch.io[/url]]
